title: OpenCode releases mobile companion app for remote desktop sessions
summary: OpenCode released companion mobile applications for iOS and Android, enabling developers to monitor active desktop agent sessions, approve tool execution permissions, inspect file diffs, and submit text or voice input remotely via OpenTunnel.
research_notes:
Install OpenCode locally and launch the CLI or background daemon on your development workstation.

Run opencode pair --remote in the terminal to generate an OpenTunnel pairing QR code and connection URL.

Install the OpenCode companion app on Android from Google Play or on iOS via TestFlight.

Scan the pairing QR code within the mobile app to connect to the active desktop session, review tool calls, and approve permissions remotely.

Keep the host machine and local OpenCode terminal session running in a persistent process or shell multiplexer so the mobile client can maintain its connection over OpenTunnel.

Verify agent tool execution prompts and file diff changes on the mobile client interface before granting authorization to run bash commands or modify repositories.

Use mobile voice dictation primarily for conceptual follow-ups, prompt adjustments, and status reviews rather than full mobile code authoring.
